scripts.start: npm run prod:frontend && npm run prod:server
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:frontend && npm run package:server && node ./scripts/create-deploy-archive.js
scripts.ansible:venv:install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools && .venv/bin/pip install -r infra/requirements.txt
scripts.deploy:ansible: npm run package && export ANSIBLE_INVENTORY=infra/inventories/local && export DEPLOY_ARTIFACT=./build/deploy.tar.gz && npm run ansible:run
